_comment: 30 questions for testing the Leave Policy RAG system. Questions 1-27 are answerable from the policy. Questions 28-30 test whether the RAG correctly handles information that is not specified in the policy.

questions.question: How many days of Casual Leave are employees entitled to per year, and can it be carried forward?
What are the rules for applying Casual Leave when advance notice is not possible?
How many days of Sick Leave are provided per year, and what is the maximum accumulation allowed?
When is a medical certificate required for Sick Leave, and where must it be submitted?
If an employee exhausts their Sick Leave during a prolonged illness, what other leave options are available?
How many days of Earned Leave are credited per year, and how are they credited for new joiners?
What happens to Earned Leave above 30 days at the end of the calendar year?
How is Earned Leave encashment calculated, and what happens if an employee leaves before completing probation?
What are the eligibility requirements and duration of Paternity Leave?
Can Paternity Leave be taken in parts, and within what period must it be used?
How many weeks of paid maternity leave are biological mothers entitled to?
How much maternity leave is provided to adoptive and commissioning mothers, and from what date is it counted?
How much leave is available for miscarriage or medical termination of pregnancy, and what proof is required?
How much leave is available after a tubectomy operation, and what are the application requirements?
How many days of Special Leave are available for an employee's birthday, wedding anniversary, and own marriage?
What happens if Special Leave falls on a weekend or declared holiday?
How many days of Bereavement Leave are provided, and which family members are included?
When does Leave Without Pay apply, and how are weekends and declared holidays treated when LWP is taken for an entire week?
What are the eligibility requirements, duration, approval requirements, and pay status for Sabbatical Leave?
Who is eligible for Election Leave, and what document must be uploaded when applying?
Can Election Leave be carried forward or encashed?
How many Optional Holidays are employees entitled to each year, and when is the list published?
What happens to an unused Optional Holiday at the end of the calendar year?
What holiday schedule must employees deployed at a client site follow?
What happens to a weekly off or declared holiday that falls within a leave period or immediately before or after it?
What are the differences between Casual Leave, Sick Leave, and Earned Leave regarding whether they can be applied post-dated?
An employee has exhausted both Casual Leave and Earned Leave. What happens if they take additional leave?
How many days of Work From Home Leave can an employee take per year according to the company policy?
Does the company policy provide a separate leave category for attending a friend's wedding?
What is the maximum number of days an employee can take as Work From Home Leave continuously?
